pattern_definitions.article_swapped: title_spanish ends with ", El/La/Los/Las/..." — article at end instead of front
pattern_definitions.spanish_only: No English title available — OMDB search must use Spanish title
pattern_definitions.bilingual_equals: raw_line contains one "=" separator between Spanish and English/other title
pattern_definitions.multi_bilingual_chain: raw_line contains 2+ "=" separators — title has 3+ language variants
pattern_definitions.truncated_director: director field ends with single capital letter (initial only), name cut off in PDF
pattern_definitions.multi_director: director field contains multiple people separated by comma
pattern_definitions.joint_director_y: director field contains Spanish "y" (and) — two co-directors
pattern_definitions.ocr_artifact: title_spanish contains triple-repeated character — likely OCR error
pattern_definitions.encoding_artifact: title_spanish contains non-standard characters outside expected Spanish unicode range
pattern_definitions.parenthetical_alt_title: title_spanish contains parenthetical with alt title, no "=" separator
pattern_definitions.period_joined_words: title_spanish has period between words with no space — PDF extraction artifact
pattern_definitions.duplicate_spanish_title: Same title_spanish appears on multiple rows with different English titles/directors

omdb_strategies.article_swapped: Move article to front: "Aldea, La" -> "La Aldea" before OMDB search
omdb_strategies.spanish_only: Search Spanish title directly; fall back to fuzzy broad search
omdb_strategies.bilingual_equals: Extract English part (after "=") for direct OMDB search
omdb_strategies.multi_bilingual_chain: Try each "=" segment independently; use longest English-looking segment first
omdb_strategies.truncated_director: Use raw_line to recover full director name for disambiguation
omdb_strategies.no_director: Title-only search; use year hint if available
omdb_strategies.multi_director: Use first director only for OMDB director field matching
omdb_strategies.joint_director_y: Split on " y " and use first director name
omdb_strategies.ocr_artifact: Use mcp0_analyze_and_match_movie for LLM normalization before search
omdb_strategies.encoding_artifact: Use mcp0_analyze_and_match_movie for LLM normalization before search
omdb_strategies.parenthetical_alt_title: Extract parenthetical content as alt title; try both variants
omdb_strategies.period_joined_words: Replace "." with " " in title before search
omdb_strategies.duplicate_spanish_title: Use title_english + director to disambiguate; match both rows separately
